items.title: Pre-market action: Here's the trade setup for today's session
items.description: Despite facing some challenges, Indian benchmark indices closed just above twenty-four thousand. The weight of elevated crude oil prices and geopolitical uncertainties impacted market sentiment. Analysts foresee a trading range for Nifty between twenty-three thousand eight hundred and twenty-four thousand six hundred. On a positive note, both foreign portfolio investors and domestic institutions showed net buying activity on Tuesday.

items.title: Midcap Street party turns selective as 15 stocks power 50% of rally
items.description: Indian midcap and smallcap indices are near record highs currently.  A few select stocks are driving most of these significant gains.  This concentration indicates a selective rally rather than broad market health.  Analysts suggest earnings growth and sector rotation are fueling this trend.  Investors should focus on balance-sheet strength and selective stock picking.

items.title: NSE, BSE equity derivatives turnover hits multi-month low in August amid CAS volatility
items.description: August saw a significant dip in equity derivatives turnover on the NSE and BSE, reaching multi-month lows. Analysts connect this downturn to the recent implementation of the Closing Auction Session, which has changed the dynamics of trading near market close. Traders are opting to exit their positions sooner to avoid potential pitfalls. The regulator reassures that this session mechanism is now a permanent feature.

items.title: FCNR rush leaves banks swimming in ₹6.65 lakh crore liquidity
items.description: Banking system liquidity has reached a four-year high as FCNR(B) inflows entered the market. This excess liquidity has pushed the weighted average call rate significantly below the repo rate. Much of this money is being parked in the RBI's variable rate reverse repo operations. Treasury heads are showing a preference for shorter tenures in these operations. Experts expect liquidity to normalize to a lower level by December.

items.title: No more hush-hush: Tax portal opens door to misconduct complaints
items.description: The Income Tax portal now allows taxpayers to report misconduct. A new tab enables complaints against officers for sexual harassment or bribery. This digital channel offers a secure and confidential reporting mechanism. Practitioners emphasize the importance of prompt and protected complaint resolution. The success of this initiative hinges on effective execution and oversight.

items.title: Coal India bets ₹50,000 crore on life beyond coal; goes big on gasification, critical minerals
items.description: Coal India is investing nearly fifty thousand crore rupees in coal gasification projects. The company is also actively seeking overseas critical mineral assets, particularly lithium. Coal India targets nine point five gigawatts of renewable capacity by the year twenty thirty. These initiatives aim to reduce import dependence and capture new growth engines. The state-run miner is establishing a robust coal gasification ecosystem in India.

items.title: Fortis Healthcare reviews Delhi HC ruling in Daiichi Sankyo case, may approach Supreme Court
items.description: In a significant development, Fortis Healthcare is assessing a recent decision from the Delhi High Court regarding the Daiichi Sankyo arbitration. The court's order for a forensic audit of earlier transactions poses a notable contingent liability for Fortis. Consequently, the company may explore the option of appealing to the Supreme Court, as this ruling could necessitate direct compensation to Daiichi Sankyo.

items.title: Indian banks slash FCNR deposit rates by up to 310 basis points
items.description: Indian banks have lowered interest rates on foreign-currency deposits significantly. This action follows the closure of the Reserve Bank of India's special swap window. Banks offered unusually high rates to attract overseas funds during the ten-week period. This special facility enabled lenders to provide substantially higher returns to depositors. The strong inflows prompted the RBI to advance the closure of this window.

items.title: Ujjivan Small Finance Bank CEO & MD Sanjeev Nautiyal steps down on health grounds
items.description: Ujjivan Small Finance Bank's MD and CEO has resigned citing health reasons. The board accepted the early retirement and appointed Carol Furtado as interim head. The bank will now begin searching for a permanent successor to Nautiyal. Nautiyal ceased his role as MD and CEO from September 1. The bank's share price saw a decline following this leadership change.

items.title: Kwality Walls shares fall 3% as RIL's foray into ice cream biz raises competition fears
items.description: Kwality Walls shares dropped on Wednesday as Reliance Consumer Products entered India’s ice cream market with Bombay Creamery, raising competition concerns. The stock extended its losing streak to seven sessions, declining 11% during the period. RCPL plans a pan-India rollout after launching the brand in western India, with prices starting at Rs 10.

items.title: Coal India shares gain 4% as August coal supplies rise 5.5% YoY: Buy, Sell or Hold?
items.description: Coal India shares rose on Wednesday after the state-run miner reported a 5.5% YoY rise in August coal supplies. Strong April-August volumes, lower pithead inventories and improving e-auction premiums lifted sentiment. Nuvama upgraded the stock to Hold and raised its target price to Rs 454, citing recovery potential.

items.title: Welspun Corp among 4 stocks flashing bullish signals, indicating possible uptrend
items.description: On September 1, four stocks in the Nifty500 appeared on the ‘White Marubozu’ bullish scanner, according to StockEdge’s technical scan data. A White Marubozu is a bullish candlestick pattern in technical analysis that occurs when the opening price is the lowest for a given period, and the closing price is the highest.Represented by a long white (or green) candlestick with no upper shadow and a small or nonexistent lower shadow, it indicates strong buying pressure throughout the session. Traders interpret it as a signal that buyers were in control from the opening to the closing, often using such patterns for informed decisions about future price movements in financial markets.

items.title: Hero MotoCorp, M&M, other auto stocks drop up to 5% despite strong August sales numbers. Should you buy the dip?
items.description: Despite strong August sales data reflecting robust demand for passenger vehicles, auto stocks faced a notable drop. Maruti Suzuki and Tata Motors both reported impressive sales increases, while Hyundai Motor India celebrated its highest domestic sales ever in August. However, tractor sales diverged from this trend, as analysts expressed worries about future demand amidst the specter of price rises and increasing inflation.

items.title: From the ashes of bear-market: Over 125 smallcap stocks soar up to 300% from 52-week lows
items.description: Smallcap stocks have shown a stunning revival after hitting recent lows, with numerous companies experiencing value increases over double their 52-week lows. This robust recovery is backed by better earnings reports and a resurgence in investor confidence. The positive trends span multiple sectors, indicating a broad-based rebound as investors increasingly redirect their focus toward smaller companies following a challenging correction period.

items.title: Why is market falling today? Sensex, Nifty selloff wipes out Rs 5 lakh crore investor wealth: 5 key factors
items.description: Indian stock markets experienced a significant downturn on Wednesday morning.  Sensex and Nifty saw substantial drops, reflecting investor concerns.  Escalating US-Iran tensions and soaring oil prices spooked market participants.  This sharp decline erased nearly Rs 5 lakh crore from market capitalization.

items.title: 2026 multibagger Welspun Corp shares in focus after signing MoU for pipe manufacturing in Jordan
items.description: Welspun Corp shares will be in focus after the company signed an MoU with Perma-Pipe International Holdings and the Jordanian government to explore setting up pipe manufacturing and advanced coating facilities in Jordan. The proposed joint venture could serve water, oil and gas, energy and infrastructure projects across Jordan and neighbouring Middle Eastern markets.

items.title: Best FII bets: 3 AI-linked stocks and up to 250% rally in Q1. Have investors missed the bus?
items.description: FIIs have remained heavy sellers of Indian equities since September 2024, with nearly $60 billion in cumulative outflows. However, Q1 shareholding data suggests they are becoming more selective, with some bets delivering strong gains. HFCL saw FII ownership more than double to over 15%, while its stock surged 214%, highlighting the payoff from targeted investments.

items.title: Vardhman Textiles among 4 stocks showing bullish RSI upswing
items.description: On September 1, four Nifty500 stocks that gained over 3% were highlighted in the RSI Trending Up scan, based on data from StockEdge.com. An uptrend signal is generated when the RSI value crosses above 50 from below. "RSI trending up" means that the Relative Strength Index (RSI) values are increasing, suggesting strengthening momentum in the price of the stock. This can indicate potential upward movement and may be used by traders to identify buying opportunities.

items.title: Sumax Engineering shares list at 10% premium over IPO price on NSE SME platform
items.description: The Rs 53.40 crore IPO, which opened for subscription on August 25, 2026, received an overwhelming response from investors. The issue was subscribed 162.94 times overall, reflecting strong demand across investor categories.

items.title: Weak Start! Annu Projects shares list at 27% discount to IPO price
items.description: The IPO opened for subscription on August 25 and closed on August 28, attracting an overall subscription of 2.93 times. Retail investors bid for 2.68 times the shares reserved for them, while the Qualified Institutional Buyers (QIB) category was subscribed 1.72 times. The Non-Institutional Investors (NII) segment recorded stronger demand, with subscription reaching 3.55 times.

items.title: Stocks in news: Reliance Industries, Wipro, Tata Motors, among 9 stocks that will be in focus today
items.description: The BSE Sensex ended at 76,944.28, lower by 12.99 points or 0.02%, as gains in IT, FMCG and select heavyweights helped limit the fall.

items.title: Welspun Corp, Perma-Pipe to invest Rs 1500 crore in Jordan pipe manufacturing JV
items.description: Welspun Corp and Perma-Pipe International Holdings are set to create a joint venture for pipe manufacturing in Jordan with an investment around ₹1500 crore. This collaboration is designed to tackle key water and energy projects in the Levant region, integrating advanced steel pipe production alongside cutting-edge anti-corrosion coating systems. The facilities will play a crucial role in supporting Jordan's National Water Carrier Project, contributing to the country's water security initiatives.

items.title: Positive Breakout: These 7 stocks cross above their 200 DMAs
items.description: In the Nifty500 pack, seven stocks' closing prices crossed above their 200 DMA (Daily Moving Averages) on September 1, 2026, according to stockedge.com's technical scan data. Traders use the 200-day daily moving average (DMA) as a key indicator to determine the overall trend in a particular stock. As long as the stock is priced above the 200-day SMA on the daily timeframe, it is generally considered to be in an overall uptrend. Take a look:

items.title: Coforge’s strong order book and execution point to better margins and growth
items.description: Coforge shares have surged ahead, outperforming the IT index with remarkable strength. The company's performance during the June quarter highlighted significant momentum and improved margins, driven by consistent order activity and strategic growth initiatives. With analysts adjusting their expectations and lifting price targets, confidence in revenue growth remains high, bolstered by anticipated continued deal flow and execution capabilities.

items.title: ICICI Bank closes in on HDFC Bank for Nifty’s top spot as share trends diverge
items.description: As ICICI Bank approaches HDFC Bank's Nifty index dominance, the dynamics of the market are changing. HDFC Bank's index weight has dropped considerably this year, while ICICI Bank's influence has grown. At the same time, Reliance Industries has seen its weight fall, increasing the distance between it and ICICI Bank. Still, Reliance proudly holds the title of the largest company in market capitalization.

items.title: BSE courts HFT firms to boost closing auction liquidity
items.description: BSE Ltd. is taking steps to engage traders in order to enhance day-end trading volumes after encountering liquidity challenges. The implementation of a new closing auction system has led to pronounced price fluctuations and diminished options turnover. According to the CEO, market participants are not experiencing the intended benefits. Since the system's rollout in August, BSE's stock has dropped sharply, prompting consideration of minor adjustments to improve efficiency.

items.title: Tough task: Staying invested in businesses while ignoring noise called Gulf war; 6 mid-cap stocks with upside potential of up to 23%
items.description: Trying to time the market turns volatility into something that beats an investor twice: Once on the way down, and once on the way up. So, instead, decide what are the good businesses that you want to own, and then go ahead and buy the shares. And use market volatility to get the best price.

items.title: Multibaggers: These 9 midcap stocks surged up to 300% in two years. Do you own any?
items.description: The Indian equity market has delivered modest returns over the past two years. The Nifty 50 slipped nearly 5% during this period, while the Nifty Midcap 150 remained in positive territory, gaining around 6%. For investors looking only at the headline indices, the period may have seemed to offer limited opportunities. But beneath those numbers lies a very different story.The real action was within the midcap universe, where a select group of companies delivered spectacular returns. Around 21 midcap stocks gained more than 50%, while nine stocks turned into multibaggers, significantly multiplying investors’ wealth in just two years. (Data Source: ACE Equity)

items.title: BSE shares slip 3% after exchange flags CAS-driven volume decline
items.description: BSE shares fell dropped on Wednesday after the exchange acknowledged that the newly introduced Closing Auction Session (CAS) had contributed to lower trading volumes. Equity derivatives turnover hit multi-month lows in August, while BSE’s average daily traded turnover declined 26% month-on-month as traders reduced activity amid heightened expiry-day volatility.

items.title: Bigger market crash ahead? Analysts weigh how Sensex, Nifty may react if US 10-year bond yield touches 5%
items.description: Global bond yields are hitting multi-year highs, with the US 10-year yield nearing 5% amid rising oil prices, inflation fears and concerns over government debt. Indian 10-year yields also crossed 7%, raising concerns about the impact of higher borrowing costs and shifting investor preference on equities.

items.title: TBZ surges over 38% in two sessions, extending gains after hitting upper circuit. What's triggering the rally?
items.description: Tribhovandas Bhimji Zaveri (TBZ) shares surged 38.9% in two sessions as investors reacted to GRT Jewellers’ proposed acquisition of the jewellery retailer. GRT plans to acquire 74.12% promoter stake at up to Rs 209 per share and launch an open offer for the remaining public stake at Rs 249.61 per share, while the stock climbed to Rs 423 on Wednesday, well above both transaction prices.

items.title: BEML shares rise 2% after securing Rs 180 crore Vande Bharat sleeper order
items.description: BEML shares gained nearly 2% after the company secured a Rs 180.60 crore order from Integral Coach Factory for manufacturing and supplying Vande Bharat sleeper trainsets. The order adds to BEML’s recent order wins, including contracts from Mauritius and Hindustan Aeronautics, strengthening its order book and presence across rail, defence and international markets.

items.title: Swiggy shares drop 4%, market value down Rs 5,000 crore in 2 days. Here’s why
items.description: Swiggy shares fell sharply on Wednesday, extending their two-session decline to 6% and erasing nearly Rs 5,000 crore in market value. The stock faces potential foreign outflows after entering the NSDL red-flag list and possible exclusion from MSCI and FTSE indices. Jefferies, however, retains a Buy rating with a Rs 435 target.

items.title: Hero MotoCorp shares fall over 4% as August exports, motorcycle dispatches decline
items.description: Hero MotoCorp shares fell after August dispatch data showed year-on-year declines in motorcycle and export volumes, despite strong scooter sales keeping overall dispatches positive. The stock’s one-week loss widened to 4.64%, underperforming the benchmark’s 1.97% decline.

items.title: How to trade HDFC Bank shares after new 52-week low? 2 technical analysts explain
items.description: HDFC Bank shares remain under pressure, falling nearly 30% so far this year as investors assess the lender’s CEO succession process. Technical analysts see a weak trend, with key support around Rs 710 and resistance near Rs 750-780, while Jefferies has identified several potential internal and external candidates for the top job.

items.title: MSCI to delete Swiggy from standard indices on foreign ownership limit breach risk
items.description: MSCI will remove Swiggy from its Global Standard Indexes on September 7, 2026, due to foreign ownership limit breaches. This deletion adds pressure on the stock, forcing passive funds to reduce exposure while limiting fresh foreign investment.

items.title: BNP Paribas said to handle half of India’s record MSCI trades
items.description: BNP Paribas executed nearly half of the record $4.2 billion in MSCI-linked Indian stock trades through the closing auction. The French bank handled about $1.9 billion, largely for global institutions, as favorable tax treatment boosts its securities-services role in India.

items.title: These mid-cap stocks with ‘Strong Buy’ & ‘Buy’ recos can rally over 25%, according to analysts
items.description: In the equity market, it is generally good to keep one eye on risk management. But there are times when it becomes a must-do. We are currently in that phase of the market. And a simple way to manage risk is to stagger your buying. Do not put all your money in at once. When volatility is high and more corrections are likely, it is always good to be less aggressive on the street.

items.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Thursday
items.description: Indian equities plunged nearly 1% before recovering, as escalating US-Iran tensions, soaring crude prices and global bond stress battered sentiment. Sensex closed 374 points lower, while Nifty fell 141 points, with analysts warning of continued bearishness below 24,000.

items.title: Market Trading Guide: Ageis Vopak Terminals among 2 stock recommendations for Thursday
items.description: Indian equities remained volatile amid global bond-market stress and West Asia tensions, with mid-caps under pressure. Analysts recommend SKF India and Aegis Vopak Terminals, citing technical breakouts, strong volumes and improving momentum for potential upside.

items.title: Two Trades for Today: A top ceramic tile maker for a 6.65% rise, a mid-cap private bank stock for an almost 6% gain
items.description: Our technical analysts identify select stocks every trading day that may gain momentum even in volatile markets. Here are the technical calls for today.

items.title: Rising global bond yields, FCNR-B inflows and SEBI's CAS to shape market dynamics: HDFC Securities CEO Dhiraj Relli
items.description: India is grappling with rising global bond yields and surging oil prices, which are heightening imported inflation. These economic challenges pose a threat to sustained corporate profits. Meanwhile, SEBI's auction initiative aims to bolster market integrity and enhance price discovery. Although RBI's new deposit guidelines provide some temporary relief amidst foreign exchange pressures, they don't offer a lasting solution.

items.title: Zerodha gets Sebi nod for merchant banking licence, formal registration awaited: Report
items.description: Zerodha’s merchant banking licence application has received Sebi clearance, enabling its expansion into investment banking after formal registration. The move broadens its financial services portfolio, strengthens its capital markets presence and positions the broker to support companies raising funds through IPOs.
